contract: DESIGN.md: preserve the CSE preparation workflow; make doorway/light functional for entry, current position and checklist count; main/production unchanged.

accessibility.evidence: 171 E2E passed, including axe rules for WCAG A/AA 2.0/2.1/2.2 on seven views and 404, English open-menu and partial states, keyboard, visible-label-in-name, reduced motion, forced colors and 320px reflow. Additional computed non-text contrast checks pass. Scope is tested criteria, not full conformance certification.

responsive.evidence: All three Playwright projects pass overflow checks; 33 fresh screenshots generated. Independent visual inspection of home, guide and checklist at all three widths found no blocking clipping. Tablet home was compacted into two columns; mobile home retains CTA before the doorway.

loading.reason: This theme introduces no asynchronous data request or delayed-content/loading state; the existing static application shell and offline cache are retained. Network loading itself is not claimed to be instantaneous.

empty.evidence: Checklist starts at 0/11 with eleven unlit segments and actionable checkboxes; empty-state screenshots exist for each width.

error.evidence: Invalid guide paths recover, corrupted storage cannot fabricate preparation, blocked writes leave memory interaction available with a notice, and unknown routes keep navigation and skip-link access. Existing regression tests reran successfully.

partial.evidence: Two nonadjacent checked items produce exactly two lit segments, remain after reload and are captured at all widths. Guide direct entry at step 3 labels position without completing checklist tasks.

success.evidence: All eleven checked items produce eleven lights and the explicit preparation-is-not-approval notice. Confirmation reset and reload return the counter to zero; the five-step guide still reaches checklist.

permission.reason: The reviewed preparation flow requests no account, personal document, location, camera, microphone or permission; no permission surface was introduced by the design.

renderedEvidence.observation: Primary action precedes doorway in the first screen; 502px additional full-page height is disclosed as a mobile tradeoff. Guide controls are now before the article; partial checklist screenshots are normalized to scroll top.
Two columns keep the full entry scene inside the tablet viewport with readable copy and five reachable links. The complete page is 231px shorter than baseline.
Entry text and navigation arch form a balanced two-column composition. Light surfaces resume below the scene; complete home is 252px shorter than baseline.
